budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Transport fragile cargo to its matching destination while choosing who carries cargo, who pays finite illumination and which stale reports to share.
task.natural_termination: All cargo is delivered or destroyed; these outcomes are distinguished in state. H=96 otherwise truncates.
task.interaction: Two transferable lanterns expand actual peer hazard observations. One-cargo carrying capacity and adjacent handoffs change peer opportunities; report relays copy aged hazard samples without refreshing timestamps.
task.observation_access: Fixed walls, all explorer/cargo positions, possession, battery and delivery status are public telemetry. Hazard positions/current pulses are visible only within Manhattan 1, or within observer distance 4 when some glowing lantern is within hazard distance 3. Walls do not occlude this abstract light. Private cargo priorities and peer memories are absent. A role may receive a timestamped one-hop report from an adjacent acting sender.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Explorer handed its lantern and remaining charge to a peer this tick
Explorer handed its held cargo to a peer this tick
Cargo delivered at its matching destination this tick
Cargo integrity reached zero this tick
Paid light is active for this snapshot

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
